guidance.whyItMatters: A contract is the declared surface a consumer, platform or reviewer relies on. Without one, exposure is discovered rather than declared.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Check every path and operation is intended, security schemes are declared, and the version matches what is deployed.
guidance.reviewWhenNotObserved: Declare the surface: an OpenAPI, GraphQL or AsyncAPI document is the first artefact a consumer asks for.

capability.label: ECZ-ID API Security for VS Code (free)
capability.note: Local review of API surfaces and their proof posture.

guidance.whyItMatters: Authentication and authorisation configuration is where access is bounded. Reviewers look for declared schemes, scopes and key handling, never values.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Confirm each security scheme in the contract has matching configuration, scopes are named, and key material lives outside the repository.
guidance.reviewWhenNotObserved: If the API is not public, record how it is protected; if it is public, declare it in the contract.

guidance.whyItMatters: A catalogue or discovery document tells machines and reviewers which APIs exist and where their contracts are.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Check the catalogue lists the current contract versions.

guidance.whyItMatters: A security policy and disclosure contact are where a reporter, a customer or an authority go first when something is wrong.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Confirm the contact is monitored and the policy states the response process.
guidance.reviewWhenNotObserved: Add a SECURITY.md or security.txt with a monitored contact.

guidance.whyItMatters: Contract tests and request collections show the declared surface is exercised, which is how drift between contract and deployment is caught.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Check the tests cover authentication failures as well as success paths.

guidance.whyItMatters: An ECZ-ID public proof reference lets a consumer or platform check the API's current public posture in Resolver. Absence is neutral.
guidance.reviewWhenObserved: Run ecz_check_target on the referenced identifier and read the ResultState and ReasonCodes.
guidance.reviewWhenNotObserved: If you operate the API, an ECZ-ID API Passport in TrustOps gives it a resolver-checkable identity.

capability.label: ECZ-ID API Passport (TrustOps)
capability.note: Set up in TrustOps. Passport issuance is an ECZ-ID platform service, not a function of this plugin.
